Blocks that install and remove software packages, with the host’s package manager.

## Install Package

Ensures one or more packages are present.

**Generates:** a `packages` promise.

### Settings

| Setting             | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Package name**    | Yes      | One package per line.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Version**         | No       | Empty: any installed version will do. A version (e.g. 1.24.0-1) installs exactly that one, latest keeps it at the newest available. Applies to every package listed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Package manager** | No       | The package_module body that installs the packages. A custom one: its name (in default:) or namespace:name. One of: **Platform default**, **apt_get (Debian, Ubuntu)**, **yum (Red Hat, CentOS, Amazon Linux)**, **dnf (Red Hat, Fedora)**, **dnf_group (dnf package groups)**, **zypper (SUSE)**, **apk (Alpine)**, **pkg (FreeBSD)**, **freebsd_ports (FreeBSD ports)**, **pkgsrc**, **slackpkg (Slackware)**, **nimclient (AIX)**, **snap**, or **Custom…** and **Custom body name**. |

### Example

The policy it generates, for example:

```cf3 {skip}
# Install nginx
packages:
  "nginx" policy => "present";
```

## Remove Package

Ensures one or more packages are absent.

**Generates:** a `packages` promise.

### Settings

| Setting             | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Package name**    | Yes      | One package per line.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Package manager** | No       | The package_module body that removes the packages. A custom one: its name (in default:) or namespace:name. One of: **Platform default**, **apt_get (Debian, Ubuntu)**, **yum (Red Hat, CentOS, Amazon Linux)**, **dnf (Red Hat, Fedora)**, **dnf_group (dnf package groups)**, **zypper (SUSE)**, **apk (Alpine)**, **pkg (FreeBSD)**, **freebsd_ports (FreeBSD ports)**, **pkgsrc**, **slackpkg (Slackware)**, **nimclient (AIX)**, **snap**, or **Custom…** and **Custom body name**. |

### Example

The policy it generates, for example:

```cf3 {skip}
# Remove telnet
packages:
  "telnet" policy => "absent";
```
